notes.title: Hexteria 1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704864/1c48c899aae453933112342279b56b7b4199c779.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Improved the UI of the settings menu
[*] Added an option to hide cursors from other players when playing online
[*] Added an option to change the default display name in the settings
[*] Added an option to cancel connecting to the server
[*] Fixed players being kicked from the match if the host continued
[*] Fixed a bug where online game would glitch if the start button was clicked repeatedly (thanks torcnein!)
[*] Fixed a bug where the Mind Control powerup would get stuck when restarting a campaign level
[*] Fixed a bug where playtesting a map and then creating a match would result in slots being pre-filled
[*] Fixed the total match time not updating in online play
[/list]
